_about: Manufacturer CCTV camera data for the CCTV tab (frontend/js/vendor-cameras.js is GENERATED from this by build_vendor_cameras.py). Every value is the manufacturer's own published figure, read on 2026-11-27 from the page named in `source`; a field the maker does not publish is null and says so in `notes`. hfov = horizontal field of view at the widest lens setting for the stated resolution; hfovTele = narrowest, only for zoom/varifocal lenses; watts = the listed maximum power consumption.
